question: Among players taller than 180 cm who had at least one attribute record between 2013 and 2015 with sprint speed ≥ 90, find the one with the highest average balance score whose potential was recorded as 61 in any of their attribute entries during that period. Return the player's name and their average balance.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123 AS player_name, AVG(pa.XCL_155) AS average_balance
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE p.XCL_126 > 180
  AND pa.XCL_131 BETWEEN '2013-01-01' AND '2015-12-31'
  AND pa.XCL_151 >= 90
  AND pa.XCL_133 = 61
GROUP BY p.XCL_121, p.XCL_123
ORDER BY average_balance DESC
LIMIT 1
